test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Pityful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The wrongly spelt word is **Pityful**.
 
• The correct spelling is **Pitiful **which means causing you to feel pity or sadness (दयनीय, कारुणिक)__.
 
 
• Example:* The **pitiful** groans of the wounded soldiers.*&l
